title: Grow personal emergency fund to 6–12 months
summary: Two to three times the W-2 target, because client concentration and payment delays create much higher cash-flow volatility.
detailsHtml:
Sizing for contractor reality

Contractors who serve a single dominant client (>50% of revenue) or work in industries with long payment cycles (advertising, government contracting, large enterprise consulting) should target 12 months. Contractors with diversified clients and net-15 or net-30 payment terms can target 6 months.

The "client off-boarding" stress test

Imagine your largest client tells you tomorrow that they're not renewing. How many months can you survive at current expense levels while you replace the revenue? That number, plus a 50% buffer, is your EF target. For most contractors, this exercise produces something between 6 and 12 months.
